v1_disposition: The v1 coverage-balanced attempt remains a valid fail-closed pre-scoring selection failure and is not repaired, deleted, or relabelled.

integrity.historical_source_warning: Historical pages may themselves be outcome-bearing; KR-015 retrospective classification is retained and no prospective upgrade is claimed.

selection.aggregate_metric_warning: This is a deliberately venue-balanced confirmatory sample; the overall aggregate is descriptive and not a population-frequency estimate.

descriptive_aggregate_400.warning: The four 100-race batches use nonidentical sampling designs; this pooled number is descriptive only and is not a clean inferential population estimate.

scientific_findings: The prior severe exact-333.3m/Toyama weakness does not survive as a stable universal rule: the new preregistered independent balanced sample produced 6/16 Top1=37.5%, materially above the temporal batch's 0/16. The earlier negative evidence remains valid but is now meeting/regime-dependent rather than a stable circumference rule.
Gifu weakness replicated strongly in the new balanced sample: 2/16 Top1=12.5%, Top3=43.75%, mean log loss 2.18763.
Earlier Yahiko weakness failed to replicate: the new balanced sample produced 13/17 Top1=76.47% and 17/17 Top3. Venue labels therefore remain unstable across meetings.
Kawasaki no longer supports a simple strong-venue label in this batch: 5/17 Top1=29.41% and mean log loss 1.87278.

Exact 335m/Maebashi was very strong in this batch at 12/17 Top1=70.59%, reinforcing that earlier circumference impressions are heterogeneous across meetings rather than monotonic track-length effects.
The wide batch-to-batch overall swing from 29%-46% Top1 without retune indicates meaningful composition/meeting/regime dependence and argues against subgroup retuning from any single batch.
falsified_or_weakened_hypotheses: STABLE_EXACT_333_3M_UNIVERSAL_WEAKNESS is not supported after balanced independent-meeting replication.
STABLE_YAHIKO_WEAKNESS is not supported after balanced independent-meeting replication.
STABLE_KAWASAKI_STRENGTH is not supported by the balanced independent-meeting replication.
retained_findings: Gifu weakness has repeated across multiple historical batches and remains a candidate descriptive finding, not an operational rule.
Frozen B1a retains nonzero ranking signal across all four historical batches, but performance is not composition-invariant.
non_claims: No venue or circumference rule is promoted to an operational betting rule.
No retune, threshold adjustment, race deletion, live betting, automatic betting, or Runtime activation is authorized by this result.
This retrospective KR-015 evidence is not prospective/live evidence.
The venue-balanced batch aggregate is not represented as the natural population performance rate.
